A small follow-up to the first release: featherdrop now has its real logo.

## Added

- **Gold logo** — a feather with a light → metallic → deep gold gradient,
  rendered as an inline SVG so it stays crisp at any size. It replaces the
  placeholder feather icon in the header, the download page, and the
  not-found page.
- **Template icon** — a 512×512 `icon.png` rendered from the logo, used as the
  Unraid Community Applications template icon.

No functional changes to upload, download, expiry, or password handling.
